contract.scope: T5 contextual harmonic degree and bass/inversion analysis v1. Consumes T2 parseChord (notes, intervals, bassRole, inversion) and KeyContext without modifying T1/T2 or persisted charts.
rules: bassRole and inversion are reused directly from T2 parseChord; chordTone with inversion >= 1 represents an inversion even without key context, whereas nonChordTone is treated as external slash bass.
KeyContext must be provided explicitly; the analyzer never infers a key automatically from chords.

Minor mode uses the natural minor scale as explicit reference; chords using raised 6th or 7th degrees typical of harmonic/melodic minor return indeterminate with reason nonDiatonicToNaturalMinor rather than being coerced as natural.
Secondary dominants, modal interchange, and other non-diatonic chromatic chords outside v1 rules return indeterminate (nonDiatonicChord) without forced interpretation.

In spellingPolicy diatonic, enharmonic equivalents differing from the diatonic scale spelling return indeterminate (enharmonicMismatch); chromaticSharps permits pitch-class degree matching against chromatic sharp output while preserving root spelling.
